description: Main source file for Playwright test setup and fixtures, including imports, fixture definitions, utility functions, classes for artifact and snapshot recording, and test extension configuration.

classes.name: SnapshotRecorder
classes.description: Handles individual screenshot or artifact snapshots during tests, managing when to capture, attach, and save snapshots.

classes.name: ArtifactsRecorder
classes.description: Manages collection of artifacts like screenshots, traces, and page snapshots during test execution, coordinating with contexts and requests.

methods.name: normalizeVideoMode
methods.description: Normalizes various video mode inputs into a standard VideoMode string.

methods.name: shouldCaptureVideo
methods.description: Determines if video should be captured based on mode and test info.

methods.name: normalizeScreenshotMode
methods.description: Normalizes screenshot mode inputs into a standard ScreenshotMode string.

methods.name: attachConnectedHeaderIfNeeded
methods.description: Attaches headers from connected browsers to test info attachments for debugging.

methods.name: resolveFileToConfig
methods.description: Resolves file paths relative to the test config file.

methods.name: resolveClientCerticates
methods.description: Resolves paths for client certificates based on test config location.

methods.name: connectOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Reads WebSocket connection options from environment variables.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Generates a descriptive title for API call steps in traces.
